function.name: SamlObjectSignerTests_getChildren
function.description: Retrieves all child nodes of a specified type from a given node. Note that the provided function is in Java 8 SDK syntax.

node.description: The parent Node from which to retrieve child nodes. This parameter can be of any type of Java object in string representation.

node_type.description: The Class object representing the type of child nodes to retrieve. Represented by <TYPE>.class This parameter can be of any type of Java object in string representation.
